title: Application of this part.
bodyText: The preferences in this part shall apply, when applicable, to procurements made pursuant to section 103D-302, or 103D-303, or both.
bodyHtml: §103D-1001.5  Application of this part.  The preferences in this part shall apply, when applicable, to procurements made pursuant to section 103D-302, or 103D‑303, or both. [L 1997, c 352, pt of §2; am L 1999, c 149, §18]
